uiEntry.title: diplomacy_button
uiEntry.script:
local m_action = nil
function SetAction(a) m_action = a end
function Action() return m_action end
function EnterClickDown() local x,y = Component.Call("Position") Component.Call("Children[0].MoveTo", x+2, y+2) end
function ExitClickDown() local x,y = Component.Call("Position") Component.Call("Children[0].MoveTo", x+1, y+1) end
function NotifySelected() Component.CallByAddress(Component.GetProperty("Notify"), "LuaCall", "Notify", Component.FindChildAddress("button_tx")) end

state.title: access
state.tooltip: For one clan to enter another's province, they must request access or declare war.||Military access is for those who wish to cross another's land peacefully.||Of course, this access could be abused and can make the clan that grants it vulnerable to a surprise attack.||For this reason, it can be difficult to negotiate and good relations between the two clans is an important factor.

state.title: access_cancel
state.tooltip: Breaking a military access deal before the allotted time is up will anger the other clan and reflect poorly on your own.||Word may spread that your clan does not honour it's promises, making it harder to negotiate in future. ||However, if you feel the other clan is untrustworthy, cancelling it may save you from a surprise attack.

state.title: break_trade
state.tooltip: You can ask a clan to join you in a trade embargo against another clan.||This is a good way of depriving an enemy of essential funds.

state.title: payments
state.tooltip: You can demand or offer payments and choose to make them a single or regular tribute.

state.title: protector
state.tooltip: If a clan looks weak, you can offer to make them a vassal to your own clan.||This means you will have to protect them when they are attacked, but will not have to join any wars they start.||In return, you receive a regular payment from them and unlimited access to their lands.

state.title: marriage
state.tooltip: Marriage between clans can improve and strengthen relations.

state.title: trade_cancel
state.tooltip: This will close all trade routes between the two clans.||Though you will lose all trade from them, it also denies them any trade income from you.

state.title: peace
state.tooltip: Peace can sometimes prove more profitable than war.||If you are at peace with a clan, you may be able to open up a trade agreement with them or even gain an ally.

state.title: war
state.tooltip: Declaring war will end any agreements with this clan.||It can sometimes lose you deals with other clans as well, as they pick sides.

state.title: alliance_cancel
state.tooltip: If an alliance is no longer in your clan's best interests, it would be wise to end it.||However, this can make your clan seem dishonourable to others and make future diplomatic negotiations harder.

state.title: alliance
state.tooltip: Allies can be asked for help in the event of war.||It is useful to be on friendly terms with a clan before requesting an alliance.

state.title: third_party
state.tooltip: You can ask that a clan changes its policy towards another.||This is useful if they are aiding one of your enemies.||The proposal is more likely to be accepted if they value your friendship over the other's.

state.title: trade
state.tooltip: Trading can provide valuable income for your clan.||To trade with another clan, you will need a trade route access to their capital.||For land trade, this means you need to share a border or have acquired military access through any other provinces standing between your two clans.||For naval trade, both clans must have a port in their capital.

state.title: request_join_war
state.tooltip: Request a clan to join you as an ally in war.||If you are the attacker, they can turn you down without breaking the alliance between you.

state.title: break_alliance
state.tooltip: You can ask that a clan breaks its alliance with another.||This is useful if they an ally of one of your enemies.||The proposal is more likely to be accepted if they value your friendship over the other's.

state.title: hostage
state.tooltip: Family members can be exchanged or given as hostages as a guarantee to an agreement.||Hostages can be used when it is hard to gain the trust of the other clan.||After eight turns, if the deal has been honoured, the hostage will be freed. If the deal is not honoured, they will be killed.
